skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic concepts, functions, and history of commercial banking.
Understand and manage the sources and assets of commercial banks.
Analyze real-world cases of commercial bank asset management.
Work in groups to research, present, and critique topics in banking and finance.
Prepare and deliver presentations on banking and finance topics.
Calculate and apply basic interest methods in commercial banking.
Understand and apply regulations and policies in commercial banking.
Analyze financial data and reports in the context of commercial banking.
Conduct research and write reports on banking and finance topics.
Manage time effectively to complete assignments and prepare for exams.
